subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — exec sponsor orientation & escalation play
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — exec sponsor orientation & escalation play

Eve — great to meet you on last week's call. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off the MAP and introduce the Redwood exec sponsors who will partner with CloudWave through evaluation and into a Q3 pilot.

High-level ask: confirm your executive sponsor and primary technical sponsor so we can align objectives and set an initial 8-week evaluation plan. I’ve attached a blank MAP template and a short checklist for SOC 2 artifacts you requested.

Proposed exec sponsors (Redwood):
- Michael Grant — Sales Lead (I’ll coordinate timelines and procurement)
- Rishi Malhotra — Head of Solutions (technical alignment, eval success criteria)

Suggested cadence & outcomes (draft):
1) Week 1 — Kickoff: confirm stakeholders, finalize scope & success metrics
2) Weeks 2–4 — Technical eval: integration, baseline latency/cost benchmarks
3) Weeks 5–7 — Pilot: workload routing, throughput validation
4) Week 8 — Decision & next-step recommendation (pilot -> dedicated)

Escalation path (short):
- Day-to-day: Redwood Solutions (Rishi) / CloudWave Eng lead
- If blocker >48hrs: Michael Grant (commercial) + assigned SE
- Executive escalation: VP/CTO level (escalation playbook attached)

Action items for today:
- Eve: confirm CloudWave exec sponsor (VP/CTO level) and legal procurement contact
- If you prefer, we can run a 30–45 min exec orientation next week to align on Q3 outcomes

Attachments: map-template.xlsx (MAP draft), soc2-snapshot.pdf (summary)

Thanks —

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference
From: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@cloudwave.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Perez <alan.perez@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — exec sponsor orientation & escalation play

Michael — thanks for the clear outline. CloudWave is excited to move forward. Quick answers from our side: 

- Exec sponsor: Alan Perez (VP Engineering) will be the executive owner for this eval. He’s looped on this reply.
- Technical sponsor: I’ll be the PM owner and Alan will engage our CTO as needed (CTO: Jonathan Miles; cc’ing separately when required).
- Legal/procurement: CloudWave Legal (legal@cloudwave.com) will handle standard contracts — they prefer a single SOW and a 60-day procurement window.

Two asks from us to help accelerate: 
1) Can you include a short appendix in the MAP that lists who owns each decision gate and procurement milestone? 
2) We need a SOC 2 artifacts summary and any data residency commitments you can provide for the pilot. The soc2-snapshot.pdf is a good start, but can you confirm retention/certification details?

We can do the exec orientation next Thursday (Jul 8) at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Best,

Eve Thompson
Director, Product Operations | CloudWave
eve.thompson@cloudwave.com | +1 617-555-0144
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@cloudwave.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — exec sponsor orientation & escalation play

Eve — welcome and thanks for naming Alan. I’ve sketched a short escalation playbook attached (exec-escalation-path.pdf) that maps decision gates to owners and SLAs. Key clarifying notes: 

- Decision gates: we’ll make the procurement decision at Week 8 based on a combined scorecard (integration, latency, cost). I’ll share the scorecard template in the MAP appendix.
- SOC 2 question: Redwood’s prod environment is SOC 2 Type II; the attached soc2-snapshot.pdf summarizes scope and controls. For retention: pilot logs are retained per contract (default 90 days) — we can add a retention SLA to the SOW if you need a different window.
- Data residency: hosted endpoints can be pinned to US regions (we have EU options as well). If CloudWave requires EU residency for pilot data, let us know and we’ll provision a region-specific instance.

Forwarded for visibility: On Mon, Jul 1, 2028 at 09:12 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com> wrote:
> Eve — great to meet you on last week's call. Per our conversation I wanted to kick off the MAP and introduce the Redwood exec sponsors who will partner with CloudWave through evaluation and into a Q3 pilot.
> 
> Attachments: map-template.xlsx, soc2-snapshot.pdf

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — exec sponsor orientation & escalation play

Thanks, Eve and Rishi — appreciate the quick responses. Confirming next steps and the July 8 exec orientation at 10am PT (calendar invite sent).

Updated action list (tracked in MAP):
- CloudWave (Eve): confirm final list of stakeholders for the orientation (Alan + one engineering lead) — due Jul 5
- Redwood (Michael): update MAP appendix with decision gate ownership and procurement milestones (attached: map-template.xlsx updated) — due Jul 5
- Redwood (Rishi + Priyom): provide scorecard and pilot runbook + exec-escalation-path.pdf (attached) — due Jul 6
- Legal: I'll introduce our legal lead to CloudWave Legal once the MAP scope is locked (expect intro after orientation)

Attachments: map-template.xlsx (updated), exec-escalation-path.pdf
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GMapKickoff (MAP folder), https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/CLDW-4821

If anything changes to timing, please flag early — our internal calendar for reserved capacity in Aug is filling up and we want to secure headroom for CloudWave's pilot.

Talk soon —

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
